verdict.rationale: Skills can be discovered through Claude Code plugin marketplaces, which the docs describe as catalogs offering 'centralized discovery' (docs-8, docs-36). The official anthropics/skills repo can be registered as a marketplace, and named skill bundles can then be installed from it (gh-1, gh-4, docs-9). A runtime probe also confirmed selective installation of a single skill from the repo (probe-rt-1). However, the catalog is plugin-level and decentralized (each marketplace is user-added), and there is no evidence of a browsable or searchable listing UI, a central registry, or a leaderboard. missing for 10: documented browse/search interface for marketplace contents, a central public registry or leaderboard of skills, independent corroboration of the discovery experience.
